feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 July 2026 12:04pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 01 July 2026 at 12:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of Ireland tracking eastwards, bringing fronts across the area later.


##Wind##

West or southwest 2 to 4, soon backing south or southwest 4 or 5, then increasing 5 to 7 later this evening, veering west or northwest 5 or 6 overnight, occasionally 7 again tomorrow morning. Decreasing 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, soon becoming mainly moderate, occasionally rough in the east later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, then occasional rain or drizzle arriving late afternoon. Becoming mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain/drizzle later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, soon veering west or northwest 3 or 4.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate soon becoming slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
